title: A table style's root w:pPr spacing applies to cell paragraphs; w:linkStyles swaps docDefaults for Normal.dotm's and pushes differing values onto Normal
source: probes build.py -> tg_*.pdf (A4, Arial 12, compat 15): TableGrid after=0 line=240 -> cell pitch 13.80 / after 0; direct line 480 -> 27.60; package 240/0 + linkStyles -> table paragraphs 16.92 (12 x 1.22 x 278/240 Aptos) and after 7.92

cases.note: style-root pPr spacing is read for cell paragraphs
the package declared 240/0, both differ from the template -> written onto Normal, outranking the table style for exactly those attributes (table pitch 16.92, after 7.92)
